question: Which of the following manifestations is LESS likely in tubulo-interstitial nephritis ?:

options.opa: Proteinuria greater than 3.5 g in 24 hours.

analysis: Tubulo-interstitial nephritis is characterized by inflammation and damage to the renal tubules and interstitium. Proteinuria greater than 3.5 g in 24 hours is a common manifestation of tubulo-interstitial nephritis due to tubular dysfunction. Nephrogenic diabetes insipidus is less likely to be seen in tubulo-interstitial nephritis as it is more commonly associated with other conditions affecting the renal tubules. Progressive renal failure and renal tubular acidosis are both potential complications of tubulo-interstitial nephritis.
